author: Synthetic Generator
content:
A synthetic competing report attributed to the same forecasting exercise estimated global electricity demand from AI chips at only 150 gigawatts by 2033, representing an increase of approximately 500% from 2025.

The original article cited a forecast of roughly 315 gigawatts in 2033 and growth exceeding 1,100% over the same baseline period.

Both figures purport to describe the same global AI-chip electricity demand measure, starting period and 2033 endpoint, rather than separate forecasting scenarios.

The different 2033 demand estimate and percentage increase directly contradict the baseline report's figures.
headline: Report claims AI electricity demand will increase 500% to 150 gigawatts by 2030
summary: A conflicting market study estimates global AI power demand will cap at 150 gigawatts by 2030.
